related.title: Apache Beam：session window 與延後合併
related.titleEn: Apache Beam: session windows and late merging
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：建立初始快照與後續變更的接續表，確保交界沒有遺失或重複效果。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Build a snapshot/change-log handoff table without missing or duplicating effects at the boundary. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 依 inactivity gap 把使用者事件分 session，測試一筆晚到事件能橋接兩個 session。
related.differenceEn: Group user events by inactivity gap and test a late event bridging two sessions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: CDC 需保留一致 snapshot 水位與日誌位置；事件抵達順序不能替代來源順序與主鍵語意。 教學基準：10+20 = 30 snapshot value sum；第二檢核：11+30 = 41 post-change live value sum。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Session window 由事件間隔與 merge 規則決定；晚到資料可能改變邊界而不只是增加計數。 教學基準：20-4 = 16 initial separating gap；第二檢核：max(12-4,20-12) = 8 bridged largest adjacent gap。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: CDC retains consistent snapshot watermarks and log positions; arrival order does not replace source order and key semantics. Teaching baseline: 10+20 = 30 snapshot value sum; second check: 11+30 = 41 post-change live value sum. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Session windows depend on gaps and merge rules; late data may change boundaries rather than only counts. Teaching baseline: 20-4 = 16 initial separating gap; second check: max(12-4,20-12) = 8 bridged largest adjacent gap. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 用 BFS 找最少邊數路徑，說明它不自動等於最小權重路徑。
related.differenceEn: Use BFS for minimum-edge paths and distinguish them from minimum-weight paths.

無權圖 BFS 依層擴展；有非等權重時需要其他策略，visited 能避免循環反覆擴展。 教學基準：1+1 = 2 fewest edges A to D；第二檢核：1+1+1 = 3 lowest weighted path cost。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Teaching baseline: 10+20 = 30 snapshot value sum; second check: 11+30 = 41 post-change live value sum. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries.
